intent: After an agent says it is finished: each agreed "done when" check marked met, not met, unverified or checking, with its proof. Unverified never counts as met. Accept when all are met, else send back.
useWhen: an agent reports a task done and the result must be checked against agreed criteria
each check needs proof a person can open: a note, a link or test output
a person may overrule the agent's verdict on a check
doNotUseWhen: what a run did, step by step, with metrics — RunDetail
reviewing the files or records an agent changed — ChangeReview
onboarding steps a person ticks off — SetupGuide

title.note: The task, e.g. "Update the EU price list".

criteria.note: { id, text, status: "met" | "not_met" | "unverified" | "checking", evidence?: { note?, href?, hrefLabel?, output?, outputLabel? }, reason?, setBy?: "agent" | "person" }[]. Not met sorts first and shows the agent's reason. Empty renders a kit Empty.

onOverride.note: (id, "met" | "not_met") => void. Mark met / Mark not met sit in the row's More actions menu, so each row has one visible action; set setBy "person" to show "set by you".

onAccept.note: Accept result, the one solid primary, shown only when every check is met.

onSendBack.note: Send back to agent: the one solid primary until every check is met, then outline beside Accept.

requirements: the Card is aria-labelledby the task title
checks are an ordered list; each status is a word beside its icon, never colour alone
evidence notes and links show inline; long output is a kit Collapsible named "<output label> for check <n>"
the row menu trigger is named "More actions for check <n>"
the met-over-total bar has an accessible name ("2 of 5 checks met")
verdict changes are announced in a polite live region; checking sets aria-busy
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local Checklist, CriteriaCard or AcceptanceList
Do not count unverified as met
Accept result is the one solid primary only when every check is met
snippet: <DoneCheck title="Update the EU price list" criteria={[{ id: "skus", text: "Every SKU has a 2027 price", status: "met", evidence: { href: "/runs/482/sheet", hrefLabel: "Price sheet diff" } }]} onOverride={override} onRecheck={recheck} onAccept={accept} onSendBack={sendBack} />
